## Triage: **cross-lane — `domain:devx` designated as the claiming lane, one PR.** `pm:queue` · `Bug` · `priority:p0` retained.

Triage seat, session `session_01SwJQDFKe8tVit3BXQ9EfR5`, R+145, 2026-09-04T18:50Z.

⚠️ **This card sat 11 hours carrying `priority:p0` and nothing else** — no `domain:*`, no `pm:*` state, no assignee. ⇒ It was invisible to every lane's candidate query **and** unclaimable under the lane table, because `domain:*` has one producer. A `p0` that no seat can see is a `p0` that nobody is working on. Recorded as a process failure, not as a criticism of the filer, who correctly left routing to triage.

### Landing points, read on `origin/main` at 18:48Z

| half | file | lane |
|:--|:--|:--|
| the rule family (`list-view-field-unknown`) | `packages/lint/src/validate-list-view-field-refs.ts` | `domain:devx` |
| the roster it is wired through | `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` | `domain:devx` |
| the publish probe (`probes.checked`) | `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` | `domain:engine` |

**`domain:devx` claims it.** The substantive half is defining what *"a field-name list on an object"* is and which keys belong to it — that is lint's, and the family already lives there. The `metadata-protocol` limb is wiring the probe to run it over **objects**, which `probes.checked` does not cover today (`{seeds:0, views:0, widgets:0}` — no `objects` key at all).

Per the cross-domain path: declare the **full file surface across both lanes** in the claim, and run the directed in-flight check against `domain:engine`'s claims before claiming.

### Why the gate is silent — the card's diagnosis, and it is the whole fix

`list-view-field-unknown` inspects `view.columns`. **The Studio app builder mints no `view` items at all** — `GET /api/v1/meta/view` returned 89 views, **0** belonging to the new package — and `highlightFields` is an **object-level** property the probes do not cover.

⇒ The reference-integrity rule has **nothing to inspect on the only artifacts Studio authors.** ⛔ Not a rule that missed a case; a rule pointed at a surface the click-path never produces.

### The acceptance bar, quoted because "warning" will not do

> Publishing a Studio draft whose `highlightFields` (or any field-name list on an object) names a field that does not exist on that object must **fail the publish** with a rule id and the offending path on screen … **Warning-level is not enough for the claim; it has to refuse.**

⭐ And the reproduction is a click-path in the **natural order**, not a contrived one: place the field, then name it. The API name auto-derives from the label (`field_10` → `health_score`) while `highlightFields` keeps the old id. ⇒ Any author who names a field after placing it produces this.

### `priority:p0` retained, with the reasoning made explicit

The filer named a concrete blocked deliverable (the promo video's single claim: *"a change made by clicking in Studio is refused by the same gate that refuses code"*), and on the pinned stack **there is nothing Studio can produce that the gate refuses**. ⛔ Triage does not downgrade a p0 filed against a named external blocker on its own reading.

⚠️ Worth stating separately for the maintainer, because it outlives the video: **the asymmetry itself is the defect.** `objectstack validate` would flag a code-authored object with an unknown `highlightFields` entry; the click path publishes it green and the app then **silently ignores the bad reference at runtime**. That is declared-not-enforced on the authoring surface AI and humans share.

⛔ **Out of scope, and by design**: code-loaded package objects are read-only in Studio (`supportsOverlay=false`, 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`) per ADR-0005/0010. ⛔ Do not treat that as part of this card.

⚠️ Measured on hotcrm `main` @ `5e08628` with `@objectstack/* 17.2.0` — an **installed pin**, not this tree. Re-verify the probe shape and the rule's scan surface on `origin/main` before implementing.

Main at `f01adfa5c`. Assignee field was empty at the read immediately before this write.
